definitions.gloss: news of someone's death; death notice
definitions.explanation: A report or announcement that someone has died, in the news or sent to friends and colleagues.

examples.japanese: {訃報|ふほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{恩師|おんし}→恩師：12598_onshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{訃報|ふほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|せっ}し→接する：12920_sessuru⟧、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: On hearing of my former teacher's death, I was lost for words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{訃報|ふほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられる→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せた→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧。
examples.english: When the famous actor's death was reported, many fans expressed their grief.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {訃報|ふほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: news of a death arrives
- {訃報|ふほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|せっ}する→接する：12920_sessuru⟧: to receive news of a death (formal)
- {訃報|ふほう}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: the obituary column

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲報|ひほう}→悲報：31264_hihou⟧: sad news in general, most often a death; more emotional and less formal.
{訃報|ふほう} is the standard word in newspapers, company notices, and condolence messages.

WATCH OUT:
- The homophone ⟦{不法|ふほう}→不法：11361_fuhou⟧ means illegal.
